zh: 今天天气真不错，我们出去散步吧。
en: The weather is really nice today. Let's go out for a walk.
ja: 今日は本当にいい天気ですね。散歩に出かけましょう。
ko: 오늘 날씨가 정말 좋네요. 산책하러 나가요.
en_semantic: The weather is really nice today. Let's go out for a walk.
en_literal: Today weather really good, we go out walk.
en_academic: The meteorological conditions prevailing at present are of an exceptionally agreeable nature. A leisurely promenade is recommended.

zh: 你能帮我带一杯咖啡吗？加糖不加奶。
en: Could you get me a cup of coffee? With sugar, no milk.
ja: コーヒーを一杯持ってきてくれませんか？砂糖入り、ミルク抜きで。
ko: 커피 한 잔 가져다 주실 수 있나요? 설탕 넣고 우유 빼고요.
en_semantic: Could you get me a cup of coffee? With sugar, no milk.
en_literal: Can you help me bring one cup coffee? Add sugar no milk.
en_academic: Would you be so kind as to procure a cup of coffee on my behalf? The addition of sugar is requested, though milk should be omitted.

zh: 不好意思，我迟到了。路上堵车很严重。
en: Sorry I'm late. The traffic was really bad.
ja: すみません、遅れました。道路がとても渋滞していて。
ko: 죄송합니다, 늦었습니다. 길이 많이 막혔어요.
en_semantic: Sorry I'm late. The traffic was really bad.
en_literal: Sorry, I late. Road traffic very heavy.
en_academic: I tender my sincere apologies for the delay in my arrival. The roadway was subject to severe traffic congestion.

zh: 周末我想去看电影，你有兴趣吗？
en: I want to go see a movie this weekend. Are you interested?
ja: 週末に映画を見に行きたいのですが、興味ありますか？
ko: 주말에 영화 보러 가고 싶은데, 관심 있으세요?
en_semantic: I want to go see a movie this weekend. Are you interested?
en_literal: Weekend I want go see movie, you have interest?
en_academic: I am contemplating attending a cinematic screening this weekend. Would this prospect be of interest to you?

zh: 这道菜味道挺好的，你是怎么做的？
en: This dish tastes really good. How did you make it?
ja: この料理はとても美味しいですね。どのように作りましたか？
ko: 이 요리 맛이 정말 좋네요. 어떻게 만들었어요?
en_semantic: This dish tastes really good. How did you make it?
en_literal: This dish taste very good, you how make?
en_academic: This culinary preparation possesses a most agreeable flavor profile. Might I inquire as to the methodology of its preparation?

zh: 最近工作压力很大，感觉需要休个假。
en: Work has been very stressful lately. I feel like I need a vacation.
ja: 最近仕事のストレスが大きくて、休暇が必要だと感じています。
ko: 요즘 업무 스트레스가 심해서 휴가가 필요할 것 같아요.
en_semantic: Work has been very stressful lately. I feel like I need a vacation.
en_literal: Lately work pressure very big, feel need take a vacation.
en_academic: The occupational demands to which I have been subjected of late have been considerable. A period of restorative leave is deemed necessary.

zh: 明天上午你有空吗？我想约你喝杯茶。
en: Are you free tomorrow morning? I'd like to invite you for a cup of tea.
ja: 明日の午前中、お時間ありますか？お茶に誘いたいのですが。
ko: 내일 오전에 시간 있으세요? 차 한잔 하고 싶어서요.
en_semantic: Are you free tomorrow morning? I'd like to invite you for a cup of tea.
en_literal: Tomorrow morning you have time? I want invite you drink tea.
en_academic: Might your schedule permit an engagement tomorrow morning? I should like to extend a cordial invitation for tea.

zh: 这家店的奶茶特别好喝，你一定要试一下。
en: The milk tea at this shop is especially good. You have to give it a try.
ja: この店のミルクティーは特においしいですよ。ぜひ試してみてください。
ko: 이 가게의 밀크티가 특히 맛있어요. 꼭 드셔 보세요.
en_semantic: The milk tea at this shop is especially good. You have to give it a try.
en_literal: This shop milk tea especially good drink, you must try one time.
en_academic: The milk tea purveyed at this establishment is of truly exceptional quality. I strongly recommend that you partake of it on at least one occasion.

zh: 晚上吃点什么好呢？我实在懒得做饭了。
en: What should we eat tonight? I really don't feel like cooking.
ja: 今夜は何を食べましょうか？本当に料理する気がしないんです。
ko: 저녁에 뭐 먹을까요? 정말 요리하기 귀찮네요.
en_semantic: What should we eat tonight? I really don't feel like cooking.
en_literal: Evening eat what good? I really lazy to cook.
en_academic: What might constitute a suitable repast for this evening? I find myself entirely disinclined to engage in culinary preparation.

zh: 我手机快没电了，你有充电器吗？
en: My phone is about to die. Do you have a charger?
ja: 携帯の電池が切れそうです。充電器を持っていますか？
ko: 핸드폰 배터리가 거의 다 됐어요. 충전기 있으세요?
en_semantic: My phone is about to die. Do you have a charger?
en_literal: My phone almost no battery, you have charger?
en_academic: The power reserve of my mobile device is approaching complete depletion. Are you in possession of a compatible charging apparatus?

zh: 等一下，我马上就到，还有两站地铁。
en: Wait a moment, I'll be there soon. Just two more subway stops.
ja: ちょっと待って、すぐ着きます。あと地下鉄で2駅です。
ko: 잠깐만요, 곧 도착해요. 지하철 두 정거장 남았어요.
en_semantic: Wait a moment, I'll be there soon. Just two more subway stops.
en_literal: Wait a moment, I soon arrive, still two subway stop.
en_academic: Kindly allow a brief interval. I shall arrive imminently, as a mere two stations remain upon the subway line.

zh: 周末跟朋友一起去爬山了，虽然累但是很开心。
en: I went hiking with friends over the weekend. It was tiring but really fun.
ja: 週末に友達と山登りに行きました。疲れたけどとても楽しかったです。
ko: 주말에 친구들과 등산 갔다 왔어요. 힘들었지만 정말 즐거웠어요.
en_semantic: I went hiking with friends over the weekend. It was tiring but really fun.
en_literal: Weekend with friend go hiking, though tired but very happy.
en_academic: I participated in a hiking expedition with friends over the weekend. Notwithstanding the physical exertion involved, the experience proved profoundly enjoyable.

zh: 你觉得这件衣服怎么样？我纠结了好久。
en: What do you think of this piece of clothing? I've been debating about it for a while.
ja: この服どう思いますか？ずっと迷っていて。
ko: 이 옷 어때요? 오랫동안 고민 중이에요.
en_semantic: What do you think of this piece of clothing? I've been debating about it for a while.
en_literal: You feel this clothing how? I struggle quite long time.
en_academic: What is your considered assessment of this particular garment? I have been engaged in deliberation regarding the matter for an extended period.

zh: 糟糕，我把钥匙忘在办公室了。
en: Oh no, I left my keys at the office.
ja: しまった、鍵をオフィスに忘れてきた。
ko: 이런, 사무실에 열쇠를 두고 왔어요.
en_semantic: Oh no, I left my keys at the office.
en_literal: Oh no, I key forget in office.
en_academic: I regret to report that my keys appear to have been inadvertently left at the office premises.

zh: 听说下个月要涨房租了，真是不小的负担。
en: I heard the rent is going up next month. That's quite a burden.
ja: 来月から家賃が上がるそうで、なかなかの負担ですね。
ko: 다음 달부터 월세가 오른다고 들었어요. 꽤 부담이네요.
en_semantic: I heard the rent is going up next month. That's quite a burden.
en_literal: Hear next month rent will go up, really not small burden.
en_academic: I have been informed that the rental tariff is to be increased commencing next month, which constitutes a financial encumbrance of considerable magnitude.

zh: 刚到家，外面下大雨，全身都淋湿了。
en: Just got home. It's pouring outside and I'm soaked all over.
ja: たった今帰宅しました。外は大雨で、全身ずぶ濡れです。
ko: 방금 집에 도착했어요. 밖에 비가 많이 와서 온몸이 다 젖었어요.
en_semantic: Just got home. It's pouring outside and I'm soaked all over.
en_literal: Just arrive home, outside heavy rain, whole body all wet through.
en_academic: I have just arrived at my residence. A torrential downpour is in progress outdoors, as a consequence of which my person has been thoroughly saturated.

zh: 你最近在看什么电视剧？给我推荐一个呗。
en: What TV shows are you watching lately? Recommend one to me.
ja: 最近どんなドラマを見ていますか？おすすめを教えてください。
ko: 요즘 무슨 드라마 보고 있어요? 하나 추천해 주세요.
en_semantic: What TV shows are you watching lately? Recommend one to me.
en_literal: You lately watch what TV show? Give me recommend one.
en_academic: What televisual content have you been following of late? I would be most grateful for a recommendation.

zh: 今天上班又迟到了，闹钟响了我都没听见。
en: I was late for work again today. I didn't even hear my alarm go off.
ja: 今日も仕事に遅刻しました。目覚ましが鳴ったのに聞こえませんでした。
ko: 오늘 또 회사에 지각했어요. 알람이 울렸는데도 못 들었어요.
en_semantic: I was late for work again today. I didn't even hear my alarm go off.
en_literal: Today go work again late, alarm ring I all not hear.
en_academic: I was once more tardy in arriving at my place of employment today. I entirely failed to perceive the sounding of my alarm device.

zh: 快递到了吗？我昨天下的单，应该今天配送。
en: Has the package arrived? I placed the order yesterday, and it should be delivered today.
ja: 宅配便は届きましたか？昨日注文したので、今日配達されるはずです。
ko: 택배 도착했나요? 어제 주문해서 오늘 배송될 예정이에요.
en_semantic: Has the package arrived? I placed the order yesterday, and it should be delivered today.
en_literal: Package arrive not yet? I yesterday place order, should today deliver.
en_academic: Has the delivery of the package been effected? The order was placed yesterday and was scheduled for delivery today.

zh: 周末想去博物馆逛逛，你去过新开的那家吗？
en: I want to visit the museum this weekend. Have you been to the newly opened one?
ja: 週末に博物館に行きたいのですが、新しくオープンしたところに行ったことありますか？
ko: 주말에 박물관에 가보고 싶은데, 새로 열린 곳 가보셨어요?
en_semantic: I want to visit the museum this weekend. Have you been to the newly opened one?
en_literal: Weekend want go museum walk walk, you been new open that one?
en_academic: I am contemplating a visit to the museum this weekend. Have you had occasion to visit the newly inaugurated establishment?

zh: 最近睡眠质量不太好，总是半夜醒来。
en: My sleep quality hasn't been great lately; I keep waking up in the middle of the night.
ja: 最近睡眠の質があまり良くなくて、いつも夜中に目が覚めてしまいます。
ko: 요즘 수면 질이 별로 좋지 않아요. 자꾸 한밤중에 깨요.
en_literal: Lately sleep quality not too good, always midnight wake up.
en_academic: My sleep quality has been suboptimal of late, characterized by recurrent nocturnal awakenings during the middle of the night.
en_semantic: My sleep quality hasn't been great lately; I keep waking up in the middle of the night.

zh: 这周末有什么计划吗？想约几个朋友聚一聚。
en: Any plans for this weekend? I'd like to get together with some friends.
ja: 今週末何か予定ありますか？友達と集まりたいのですが。
ko: 이번 주말에 계획 있으세요? 친구들 몇 명 모이려고요.
en_literal: This weekend have what plan? Want gather few friend together.
en_academic: What arrangements have you made for this weekend? I should like to convene a gathering of several friends.
en_semantic: Any plans for this weekend? I'd like to get together with some friends.

zh: 你家离公司远吗？每天通勤要多久？
en: Is your home far from the office? How long is your daily commute?
ja: ご自宅は会社から遠いですか？毎日の通勤にどのくらいかかりますか？
ko: 집이 회사에서 머나요? 매일 통근하는 데 얼마나 걸려요?
en_literal: Your home from company far? Every day commute need how long?
en_academic: What is the distance between your residence and place of employment? What duration is required for your daily commute?
en_semantic: Is your home far from the office? How long is your daily commute?

zh: 这个电影评分很高，我们去看首映吧。
en: This movie has very high ratings. Let's go see the premiere.
ja: この映画は評価がとても高いです。初日に行きましょう。
ko: 이 영화 평점이 아주 높아요. 개봉 첫날 보러 가요.
en_literal: This movie score very high, we go see premiere.
en_academic: This cinematic production has garnered exceptionally high ratings. Let us attend the premiere screening.
en_semantic: This movie has very high ratings. Let's go see the premiere.

zh: 我最近在学做菜，已经会做几个简单的菜了。
en: I've been learning to cook recently and can already make a few simple dishes.
ja: 最近料理を習っていて、もういくつかの簡単な料理が作れるようになりました。
ko: 요즘 요리 배우고 있는데, 벌써 간단한 요리 몇 가지는 할 수 있어요.
en_literal: I lately learn cook, already can make several simple dish.
en_academic: I have been acquiring culinary skills of late and have already achieved proficiency in preparing several straightforward dishes.
en_semantic: I've been learning to cook recently and can already make a few simple dishes.

zh: 身体健康最重要，别总是熬夜加班。
en: Health is the most important thing. Don't always stay up late working overtime.
ja: 健康が一番大切です。いつも夜更かしして残業しないでください。
ko: 건강이 제일 중요해요. 항상 밤새워 야근하지 마세요.
en_literal: Body health most important, don't always stay up late overtime.
en_academic: One's physical health is of paramount importance. It is inadvisable to habitually remain awake late engaging in overtime work.
en_semantic: Health is the most important thing. Don't always stay up late working overtime.

zh: 下个月打算去日本旅游，有什么推荐的地方吗？
en: I'm planning to travel to Japan next month. Any recommended places?
ja: 来月日本に旅行する予定です。おすすめの場所はありますか？
ko: 다음 달에 일본 여행 가려고 하는데, 추천할 만한 곳 있어요?
en_literal: Next month plan go Japan travel, have what recommend place?
en_academic: I am planning to undertake a journey to Japan next month. Are there any locations you would recommend?
en_semantic: I'm planning to travel to Japan next month. Any recommended places?

zh: 最近健身效果不错，瘦了三公斤。
en: My fitness routine has been paying off lately; I've lost three kilograms.
ja: 最近のフィットネスの効果が出ていて、3キロ痩せました。
ko: 요즘 운동 효과가 좋아서 3킬로그램 빠졌어요.
en_literal: Lately fitness effect good, lose three kilogram.
en_academic: My fitness regimen has been yielding favorable results of late, as evidenced by a reduction of three kilograms in body mass.
en_semantic: My fitness routine has been paying off lately; I've lost three kilograms.

zh: 你听说了吗？隔壁新开了家很不错的日料店。
en: Have you heard? A really good Japanese restaurant just opened next door.
ja: 聞きましたか？隣にすごくいい日本料理店が新しくオープンしたんです。
ko: 들었어요? 옆에 꽤 괜찮은 일식집이 새로 열렸대요.
en_literal: You hear not yet? Next door new open one very good Japanese restaurant.
en_academic: Have you been apprised of this development? An excellent Japanese restaurant has recently commenced operations in the adjacent premises.
en_semantic: Have you heard? A really good Japanese restaurant just opened next door.

zh: 这双鞋穿着很舒服，我打算再买一双。
en: These shoes are very comfortable. I'm thinking of buying another pair.
ja: この靴はとても履き心地がいいので、もう一足買おうと思っています。
ko: 이 신발 정말 편해서 하나 더 살까 생각 중이에요.
en_literal: This pair shoe wear very comfortable, I plan again buy one pair.
en_academic: These shoes provide an exceptionally comfortable wearing experience. I am contemplating the purchase of an additional pair.
en_semantic: These shoes are very comfortable. I'm thinking of buying another pair.

zh: 最近天气变化很大，要注意保暖。
en: The weather has been changing a lot lately. Make sure to stay warm.
ja: 最近天気の変化が大きいので、暖かくしてくださいね。
ko: 요즘 날씨 변화가 심하니까 따뜻하게 입으세요.
en_literal: Lately weather change very big, need pay attention keep warm.
en_academic: Meteorological conditions have been subject to considerable fluctuation of late. It is advisable to take measures to maintain adequate warmth.
en_semantic: The weather has been changing a lot lately. Make sure to stay warm.

zh: 你觉得我们应该几点出发比较合适？
en: What time do you think we should leave?
ja: 何時に出発するのが適切だと思いますか？
ko: 몇 시에 출발하는 게 적당할 것 같아요?
en_literal: You think we should what time set out more appropriate?
en_academic: At what time do you consider it most appropriate for us to depart?
en_semantic: What time do you think we should leave?

zh: 这件事我得好好考虑一下再做决定。
en: I need to think this through carefully before making a decision.
ja: この件はよく考えてから決めなければなりません。
ko: 이 일은 잘 생각해 보고 결정해야 해요.
en_literal: This matter I need good good consider then make decision.
en_academic: This matter warrants thorough deliberation on my part prior to the formulation of a decision.
en_semantic: I need to think this through carefully before making a decision.

zh: 周末在家看看书喝喝茶，挺好的。
en: It's nice to stay home on weekends reading books and drinking tea.
ja: 週末は家で本を読んだりお茶を飲んだりするのがいいですね。
ko: 주말에 집에서 책 읽고 차 마시는 게 좋아요.
en_literal: Weekend at home read book drink tea, very good.
en_academic: Remaining at home during the weekend engaged in reading and tea consumption constitutes a most agreeable pastime.
en_semantic: It's nice to stay home on weekends reading books and drinking tea.

zh: 谢谢你帮了我这么大的忙，改天请你吃饭。
en: Thank you for helping me so much. I'll treat you to a meal sometime.
ja: こんなに助けてくれてありがとう。今度ご飯をごちそうします。
ko: 이렇게 많이 도와줘서 고마워요. 다음에 밥 살게요.
en_literal: Thank you help me so big favor, another day treat you eat meal.
en_academic: I am most grateful for the considerable assistance you have rendered. I shall treat you to a meal on a future occasion.
en_semantic: Thank you for helping me so much. I'll treat you to a meal sometime.

zh: 好久没见了，你最近过得怎么样？
en: Long time no see. How have you been lately?
ja: 久しぶりですね。最近いかがお過ごしですか？
ko: 오랜만이에요. 요즘 어떻게 지내세요?
en_literal: Long time no see, you lately how?
en_academic: A considerable interval has elapsed since our last encounter. How have you been faring of late?
en_semantic: Long time no see. How have you been lately?

zh: 我家附近新修了一个公园，环境很好。
en: A new park has been built near my home, and the environment is great.
ja: 家の近くに新しい公園ができて、環境がとてもいいです。
ko: 우리 집 근처에 새 공원이 생겼는데, 환경이 아주 좋아요.
en_literal: My home nearby new build one park, environment very good.
en_academic: A new park has been constructed in the vicinity of my residence, wherein the environmental conditions are of excellent quality.
en_semantic: A new park has been built near my home, and the environment is great.

zh: 今晚的夕阳特别美，我拍了好多照片。
en: The sunset tonight was especially beautiful. I took a lot of photos.
ja: 今夜の夕日は特に美しくて、たくさん写真を撮りました。
ko: 오늘 저녁 노을이 특히 예뻐서 사진을 많이 찍었어요.
en_literal: Tonight sunset especially beautiful, I take many photo.
en_academic: This evening's sunset was of exceptional beauty. I captured numerous photographic images of the spectacle.
en_semantic: The sunset tonight was especially beautiful. I took a lot of photos.

zh: 最近在看一本很有意思的小说，推荐给你。
en: I've been reading a really interesting novel lately. I recommend it to you.
ja: 最近とても面白い小説を読んでいます。おすすめします。
ko: 요즘 아주 재미있는 소설을 읽고 있어요. 추천합니다.
en_literal: Lately reading one very interesting novel, recommend to you.
en_academic: I have been perusing a novel of considerable interest of late. I commend it to your attention.
en_semantic: I've been reading a really interesting novel lately. I recommend it to you.

zh: 明天要早起赶火车，今晚得早点睡。
en: I need to get up early tomorrow to catch a train, so I should go to bed early tonight.
ja: 明日は早く起きて電車に乗らなければならないので、今夜は早く寝なければ。
ko: 내일 일찍 일어나서 기차 타야 해서, 오늘 밤 일찍 자야 해요.
en_literal: Tomorrow need early get up catch train, tonight must early sleep.
en_academic: An early rising is necessitated tomorrow in order to catch a train. Consequently, I must retire to bed at an early hour this evening.
en_semantic: I need to get up early tomorrow to catch a train, so I should go to bed early tonight.

zh: 这家咖啡店的氛围很好，适合安静地工作。
en: This café has a great atmosphere and is suitable for quiet work.
ja: このカフェは雰囲気がとても良くて、静かに仕事をするのに適しています。
ko: 이 카페 분위기가 정말 좋아서 조용히 일하기 좋아요.
en_literal: This coffee shop atmosphere very good, suitable quiet work.
